newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-North sees better profit growth.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-North sees better profit growth.

text.p: Minerals, forest products and mining equipment group North Ltd said on Monday it expected to have improved profit growth over the coming years as new projects, including the Bajo De La Alumbrera copper-gold mine in Argentina, came on stream.
The company said it expects the market for iron ore to remain flat, while uranium should remain strong and zinc show an improvement next year.
North said it expects further weakness in the copper prices, but said its hedging programme "ensures it is substantially protected in the coming years."

Improvements in the woodfibre market, following the recent easing of export licensing restrictions, are likely to flow through the company's results in 1997/98 following a further period of market weakness, North said.
